contract.task_clause:
Which of the following factors should an external auditor obtain updated information about when assessing an internal auditor’s competence?
Option A: The reporting status of the internal auditor within the organization.
Option B: The educational level and professional experiences of the internal auditor.
Option C: Whether policies prohibit the internal auditor from auditing areas where relatives are employed.
Option D: Whether the board of directors, audit committee, or owner-manager oversees employment decisions related to the internal auditor.
